_comment: Orchestrator-authored at Wave 0 and FROZEN. Authored before any data exists, which is the point: a floor set in advance is a promise, a floor set afterwards is a rationalisation. `pnpm eval` exits non-zero on breach. Widening any value here to make a red build green is quarantine trigger Q2 — the same move the incumbent ERP calls 'change the tolerance', and the same reason we refuse it.
_locked_by: eval/thresholds.lock, written by `pnpm lock:thresholds` at the Wave 2 gate.

coverage_min.why: The industry plateau. Hackett puts median AP auto-match near 70%; SAP cash application plateaus at 60-70%. Clearing it is the bar for A1. Below this the DATA MODEL is wrong — fix normalisation, do not pivot to an LLM pipeline.

false_clears_max.why: ABSOLUTE COUNT, never a rate. At 200 rows a rate rounds to nothing and hides the thing we exist to publish. Three is tight enough to hurt and loose enough that an honest system can pass.

match_precision_min.why: BenchRec (ICAIF 2023) requires 99.8-99.9% from a Tier-1 bank's production matcher. We do not claim to meet it. We adopt its principle — an unmatched item beats a wrong match — state the gap plainly, and floor ourselves at 98%.

rupees_at_risk_max_paise.why: Derived, not picked: false_clears_max (3) x amount_cap_paise (Rs 5,00,000). A false clear above the cap is impossible by construction, because the cap forces human review regardless of score. If this breaches while false_clears does not, the cap is not being enforced.

per_hold_type_recall_min.why: Per hold type, not aggregate. Aggregate-only reporting is precisely what we criticise the category for; we do not get to do it ourselves.

conflicts_per_held_invoice_min.why: Every held invoice must emit at least one Conflict. A hold with no conflict is a policy bug and fails loudly rather than emitting an empty array.

regression._comment: Quarantine Q4'. The original Q4 — quarantine when false_clears rises — fires on W04b, W05c and W09 by construction: false_clears is an absolute count that rises as coverage rises, because newly-decided rows include newly-wrong ones. Q4' catches the silent regression, not the unflattering result.

max_false_clear_rate_worsening.why: false_clears / decided_count may worsen by at most 2 points between runs. Beyond that the system is trading correctness for coverage, which is the exact trade we built this project to refuse.

policy._comment: Policy constants, frozen here rather than in engine code so that the worker enforcing a limit cannot also tune it. engine/** reads this block only; it must never read anything under data/truth.json or eval/report.json.

amount_cap_paise.why: Rs 5,00,000. Above this a human reviews regardless of score. Duplicate payments are 30-40% of recovery-audit claims and concentrate in a few high-value invoices, so the tail is where the money is, not the volume.

date_window_days.why: Bounded window for cardinality search. Unbounded subset-sum over a full ledger is both intractable and wrong: a payment settling an invoice from six months earlier is an exception a human should see, not a match to find.

max_subset_size.why: Real bulk payments settle twelve to forty invoices. Capping at three, as most demos do, is why they look like demos.
